# Ai Deal Deck

> Ai Deal Deck sells do-it-yourself AI toolkits, called cards, for real estate agents and team leads. Each card is a spreadsheet, a playbook and a copy-and-paste prompt. The buyer pastes the prompt into Claude (Anthropic's AI assistant) and Claude helps them set the tool up in about 20 minutes, with the option of a live dashboard built inside Claude.

Ai Deal Deck is a brand of The Showing Partner LLC (Wisconsin, USA). It is independent and is not made or endorsed by Anthropic.

## Products

- [The AI Agent Deck](https://aidealdeck.com/): all five cards plus two bonus cards. Launch price $49 through November 30, 2026; regular price $199 from December 1, 2026.
- [Real Estate KPI Tracker](https://aidealdeck.com/cards/kpi-tracker/): A real estate KPI tracker that shows your conversion rate at every step, from lead to closing, and the weekly number that gets you to your goal. Launch price $19 through November 30, 2026; regular price $49.
- [Listing Exposure Playbook](https://aidealdeck.com/cards/listing-exposure-playbook/): A repeatable 14-day listing launch plan for real estate agents, with fill-in templates and day-7 and day-14 seller reports. Launch price $19 through November 30, 2026; regular price $49.
- [Lead-for-Life System](https://aidealdeck.com/cards/lead-for-life-system/): A lead follow-up system for real estate agents: fast first contact, a set follow-up plan until they book, a speed scorecard and a TCPA checklist. Launch price $19 through November 30, 2026; regular price $49.
- [Commission & GCI Ledger](https://aidealdeck.com/cards/commission-gci-ledger/): A commission and GCI tracker for real estate agents: every closing, fee, referral fee and split in one place, with team totals kept separate from your own income. Launch price $19 through November 30, 2026; regular price $49.
- [VA Playbook & Scorecard](https://aidealdeck.com/cards/va-playbook-scorecard/): A real estate virtual assistant playbook: a narrow role with three jobs, a daily routine, an end-of-day report and a weekly scorecard. Launch price $19 through November 30, 2026; regular price $49.
- [Free cards: Listing Watchdog and Morning Brief](https://aidealdeck.com/free/): free download. Listing Watchdog tells an agent when a past client or lead they are watching lists with another agent. Morning Brief is one short summary from Claude each morning.
- [Live demo](https://aidealdeck.com/demo/): a playable sample of the KPI dashboard, with sample data.

## What buyers need

- The Claude desktop app and a paid Claude plan (sold separately by Anthropic; heavier use may need a higher plan)
- Google Sheets or Excel
- A CRM is optional

## Facts

- Is it done for me? No. It's a do-it-yourself toolkit. Setup takes about 20 minutes per card: paste one prompt into Claude, answer simple questions, and approve what it sets up. The Lead-for-Life System takes another hour or two to build your follow-up plan in your CRM and write your own emails.
- What else do I need? The Claude desktop app and a paid Claude plan (Claude Pro is currently $20/month), sold separately by Anthropic. The more cards you run and the more often they update, the more of your Claude plan they use, so you may need a higher plan as you grow. Google Sheets or Excel. A CRM is optional; if Claude has a connector for it, Claude can read it directly.
- Will it contact my leads for me? No. It drafts messages for you to review and send. It never texts, calls or emails anyone on its own.
- Will it get me more deals? We don't promise more leads, listings, closings or income. It shows you your numbers and what needs you; results depend on your work.
- Can I get a refund? All sales are final because the files are delivered instantly and you keep them. Please read this page and the Terms before you buy. If a file is missing or won't open, email us and we'll fix it.
- Do I get a spreadsheet or a dashboard? Both are in the box and you choose. Every card comes with a workbook for Google Sheets or Excel. During setup Claude asks whether you want a live dashboard as your main view; if you say yes, Claude builds it for you inside Claude from your own numbers, and the workbook stays as the place your data lives. You can try a sample dashboard before you buy.
- Can I try it before I buy? Yes. Two cards are free: the Listing Watchdog and Morning Brief. There is also a live demo of the KPI dashboard with sample data.
- Can I talk to someone? Yes. Call (414) 946-6479 any time; Sarah answers around the clock and can walk you through the cards. Or email support@aidealdeck.com.
- Is this made by Anthropic? No. Ai Deal Deck is an independent product built to work with Claude. It is not made or endorsed by Anthropic.
